name: Noble
description: Members of the ruling classes, whether through inheritance, election, or appointment.

assignments.name: Administrator
assignments.description: You serve as a bureaucrat or functionary in a government.

assignments.name: Diplomat
assignments.description: You serve as a representative of your world or faction.

assignments.name: Dilettante
assignments.description: You are a wastrel with too much money and not enough sense.

events.description: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Mishap table but remain in career.

effects.detail: Roll on Mishap table, stay in career

events.description: You are challenged to a duel for your honour and standing.
events.effectDescription: If you refuse, reduce SOC by 1. If you accept, roll Melee (Blade) 8+. Succeed: gain SOC +1. Fail: roll on the Injury table plus lose SOC -1.

effects.detail: Refuse (SOC -1) or accept duel (Melee 8+ for SOC +1 or Injury + SOC -1)

events.description: Your time as a noble gives you a wide range of experiences.
events.effectDescription: Gain one of Animals (Riding) 1, Art 1, Carouse 1 or Streetwise 1.

effects.detail: Gain Animals (Riding) 1, Art 1, Carouse 1 or Streetwise 1

events.description: You inherit a gift from a rich relative.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

events.description: You are given advanced training in a specialist field.
events.effectDescription: Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.

events.description: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Life Events table.

events.description: A conspiracy of nobles against the ruling house involves you. You can join them, gaining them as Allies and the target as an Enemy. If you refuse, gain them as Enemies and the target as an Ally.
events.effectDescription: Join conspiracy: gain Allies and target Enemy. Refuse: gain Enemies and target Ally.

events.description: Your reign is acclaimed by all.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.

events.description: You make an alliance with a powerful and charismatic noble.
events.effectDescription: Gain an Ally. Either gain Leadership 1 or gain DM+4 to your next advancement roll.

events.description: Your efforts expand your domain and increase your standing.
events.effectDescription: Gain one level of any skill and DM+2 to your next advancement roll.

events.description: Your standing and influence increase enormously.

mishaps.effectDescription: Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.

effects.detail: Roll twice on Injury table, take lower result

mishaps.description: A family scandal forces you out of your position.
A disaster or war devastates your family's holdings. Lose all Benefit rolls from this career.
mishaps.effectDescription: Lose all Benefit rolls from this career.

effects.detail: Lose all Benefit rolls from this career

mishaps.description: Political manoeuvrings usurp your position. Gain a Rival. Gain Diplomat 1 or Advocate 1.
mishaps.effectDescription: Gain a Rival. Gain Diplomat 1 or Advocate 1.

mishaps.description: An assassin attempts to end your life. Roll END 8+. If you fail, roll on the Injury table.
Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
